title: Bound demon deploy
kicker: Lawn · first core · summon and fusion
loopLine: Lawn — first core · Summon and fusion
hook: **Deploy** bound roster demons into a lawn run — usually as plant-side avatars, sometimes as designated hypno-zombie allies.

blindSpots.meaning: Send a bound specimen onto the live lawn board for this match — not an altar pull and not an expedition dispatch.
Most demons appear as empowered plant-side uniques carrying that specimen’s traits and element.
Designated boss-class species can deploy as hypno-zombie allies instead of plant avatars.
A specimen already out on an expedition cannot lawn-deploy (and the reverse). No double-dipping.
Pacts keep demons on your roster ready to field — see [pacts and loyalty](pacts-loyalty).

alsoTrue: They fight with the traits and element you gave them — combat language still applies.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Your raised demons come back onto the board as deployable presence.
Most arrive as plant-side avatars. A smaller set of boss-class designations can arrive as hypno-zombie allies.

sections.title: How it works
sections.intro: Bind first, then field when free:

cards.name: Bind
cards.body: Keep demons on pacts so they are roster-ready.

cards.name: Check locks
cards.body: Expedition soft-locks block lawn deploy until the idle job is clear.

cards.name: Deploy
cards.body: During a match, send an eligible specimen onto the lawn.

diagram: pact-bound specimen  ->  (not on expedition?)  ->  deploy into lawn match

groups.title: During a match
steps: Bind demons on pacts in the control room.
Start a lawn match and open Lawn.
Deploy specimens that are not locked on an expedition.
groups.note: If a name is greyed or blocked, check expeditions before assuming a bug.

doSteps: Confirm at least one specimen is bound on a pact.
Make sure it is not out on an expedition.
During a match, deploy it and watch it appear on the mirror.
doNote: Parent loop: [lawn match](lawn-match). Soft-locks also protect expedition integrity — see [expeditions](expeditions).

mixUps.q: Why can’t I deploy this demon?
mixUps.a: Often soft-locked on an expedition — or not bound. Check both.

mixUps.q: Is deploy the same as summoning at the altar?
mixUps.a: No. Altar creates/binds. Deploy fields someone you already have into a match.
Most do as plant-side avatars. Designated boss-class species can be hypno-zombie allies.

mixUps.q: Can one specimen be on lawn and expedition at once?

mixUps.a: No. They carry the traits and element you gave them.
